paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.39% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.09%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.96%). Brent crude changed +0.03% to 98.32. Among the firms tracked, Franklin Templeton (+4.72%) and Deutsche Bank (-4.34%) moved the most.
